title: Generate a file with random bytes
summary: Create a file filled with random data using the system's random number generator. Useful for testing or creating dummy files.

steps.explain: Create a file containing random bytes. Replace <BLOCK_SIZE> with the size of each block in bytes (e.g., 100), <COUNT> with the number of blocks (e.g., 1), and <OUTPUT_FILE> with the path to the new file.

placeholders.name: BLOCK_SIZE
placeholders.description: Size of each block in bytes

steps.expect: A new file is created at the specified path containing random data.
